description: A request to aggregate a column as a facet in search results.

columnName.description: The name of the column to aggregate.

maxValueCount.description: Maximum number of facet values to return. Default: 25.

sortField.description: The field to sort facet values by. Maps to OpenSearch terms aggregation order keys: '_count' (bucket document count), '_key' (bucket key), or any sub-aggregation name. Default: '_count'.

sortDirection.description: The direction to sort facet values. Default: DESC.
